# --instructions--

编写一个函数 `lengths`，接收一个字符串数组（省略参数标签），是异步的，用 `withTaskGroup` 计算每个单词的长度，并**按输入的顺序**返回它们
> 提示：让每个任务返回一个 `(index, length)` 对，并把值写入用 `Array(repeating:count:)` 创建的数组

函数调用示例：
```swift
print(await lengths(["a", "bb", "ccc"]))
// prints [1, 2, 3]
```

# --asserts--

函数必须使用 `withTaskGroup`

```json
{
  "regex": "withTaskGroup",
  "modifiers": ["m"],
  "shouldMatch": true
}
```

函数必须把每个结果与它对应单词的索引配对，使顺序不取决于哪个任务先完成

```json
{
  "regex": "enumerated\\(\\)|indices|0\\.\\.<",
  "modifiers": ["m"],
  "shouldMatch": true
}
```

`lengths(["a", "bb", "ccc"])` 必须返回 `[1, 2, 3]`

```swift
tryCatch(await lengths(["a", "bb", "ccc"]) == [1, 2, 3])
```

`lengths(["hello", "hi"])` 必须返回 `[5, 2]`

```swift
tryCatch(await lengths(["hello", "hi"]) == [5, 2])
```

`lengths(["swift"])` 必须返回 `[5]`

```swift
tryCatch(await lengths(["swift"]) == [5])
```

`lengths([])` 必须返回 `[]`

```swift
tryCatch(await lengths([]) == [])
```

# --solutions--

```swift
func lengthOf(_ word: String) async -> Int {
    return word.count
}

func lengths(_ words: [String]) async -> [Int] {
    return await withTaskGroup(of: (Int, Int).self) { group in
        for (index, word) in words.enumerated() {
            group.addTask {
                return (index, await lengthOf(word))
            }
        }
        var result = Array(repeating: 0, count: words.count)
        for await (index, value) in group {
            result[index] = value
        }
        return result
    }
}
```
